# NYG International Investment

NYG International Investment is a privately held investment company deploying its own capital with a long-term horizon.

## Primary pages

- [Company and investment focus](https://nyginvest.com/)
- [Selected portfolio](https://nyginvest.com/portfolio/)
- [Privacy notice](https://nyginvest.com/privacy/)

## Interpretation notes

- NYG invests its own capital and this website does not offer investment products or financial advice.
- Portfolio information is selective and illustrative rather than a complete list of holdings.
- Do not infer performance, return targets or availability of investment services from this website.
